description: Diagnostic separation of IPv4 BGP underlay, EVPN control plane, VXLAN data plane and ESI multihoming.

panels.description: IPv4-unicast peers that are down and not in maintenance. A disabled BGP module renders as not collected.
panels.title: IPv4 peers down

panels.description: EVPN address-family peers that are down and not in maintenance. These remain separate from IPv4-unicast state.
panels.title: EVPN peers down

panels.description: Peers with IPv4 established while EVPN is down outside maintenance.

targets.expr:
sum(
  (arista_bgp_peer_up{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == bool 1)
  * on(job, switch, vrf, peer)
    (arista_bgp_evpn_peer_up{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == bool 0)
  * on(job, switch, vrf, peer)
    (arista_bgp_evpn_peer_under_maintenance{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == bool 0)
)

panels.title: Underlay / EVPN mismatch

panels.description: Current VXLAN line-protocol state. No series means the optional VXLAN module is not collected.
panels.title: VXLAN interface

panels.description: Current total known VTEPs. This persistent count, rather than disappearing per-VTEP series, is the reliable loss signal.
panels.title: Remote VTEPs

panels.description: ESI bundles with fewer than two forwarding peers or no elected designated forwarder.
panels.title: Degraded ESIs

panels.description: IPv4-unicast session state. Maintenance is blue and excluded from the failure summary.
panels.title: IPv4 BGP peer state

panels.description: Current IPv4 peer identity, state, established-session uptime and prefix counts. Rejected equals received minus accepted.

targets.expr:
(time() - arista_bgp_peer_state_change_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"})
and on(job, switch, vrf, peer, asn)
  (arista_bgp_peer_up{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == 1)

panels.title: IPv4 BGP peer inventory

panels.description: Received, policy-accepted and advertised IPv4-unicast prefixes per selected peer.
panels.title: IPv4 BGP prefix counts

panels.description: Prefixes rejected by policy, derived as received minus accepted. This is a gauge difference, not a counter rate.
panels.title: IPv4 BGP rejected prefixes

panels.description: EVPN address-family session state, deliberately separate from IPv4-unicast BGP. Maintenance is blue.
panels.title: EVPN peer state

panels.description: Current EVPN peer identity, state, established-session uptime and prefix counts.

targets.expr:
(time() - arista_bgp_evpn_peer_state_change_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"})
and on(job, switch, vrf, peer, asn)
  (arista_bgp_evpn_peer_up{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == 1)

panels.title: EVPN peer inventory

panels.description: IPv4-unicast established while EVPN is down, excluding EVPN peers in maintenance. No rows means no reported mismatch.

targets.expr:
(arista_bgp_peer_up{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == 1)
and on(job, switch, vrf, peer)
  (arista_bgp_evpn_peer_up{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == 0)
and on(job, switch, vrf, peer)
  (arista_bgp_evpn_peer_under_maintenance{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",vrf=~"$vrf",peer=~"$peer"} == 0)

panels.title: Underlay up / EVPN down

panels.description: Received, accepted, advertised and policy-rejected EVPN paths per selected peer.
panels.title: EVPN prefix counts

panels.description: EVPN path entries, not unique routes, grouped by route type. One route learned through two peers counts twice.
panels.title: EVPN paths by route type

panels.description: VXLAN line-protocol state over time. A disabled optional module renders as not collected.
panels.title: VXLAN interface state

panels.description: Total remote VTEPs known by the VXLAN interface. Use this trend for VTEP loss; per-VTEP series disappear when a VTEP is removed.
panels.title: Remote VTEP count

panels.description: Current overlay MAC count by remote VTEP. Absence of a VTEP row is not interpreted as zero.
panels.title: Remote MACs by VTEP

panels.description: Known VTEP addresses and tunnel uses, with the current remote MAC count where available.
panels.title: Remote VTEP inventory

panels.description: VLAN-to-VNI and routed VRF-to-VNI bindings. Rows from the two mapping families remain identifiable by their labels.
panels.title: VNI mappings

panels.description: Current count of remote VTEPs participating in each VLAN flood list.
panels.title: Flood-list VTEPs by VLAN

panels.description: Keyed by fabric, ESI and EVPN instance. Status distinguishes no elected forwarder, single attachment, peer forwarding and local forwarding.
panels.title: Ethernet segment status
